name: Blytheville Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Founded in Blytheville, Arkansas in 1974, Blytheville Sheet Metal is a family-owned fabrication shop now in its third generation. We serve commercial, industrial, and agricultural clients across the southeastern United States with custom sheet metal fabrication, precision fiber laser cutting, heavy crane services, and cotton gin maintenance for over 100 gins across the region.
about:
Blytheville Sheet Metal was founded in 1974 in Blytheville, Arkansas, by Dwight Wren. The family-owned fabrication shop is now in its third generation, led by Wren's son Randall and grandsons Austin and Jace.

The company provides custom sheet metal fabrication, precision fiber laser cutting (up to 1¼-inch plate on 5-by-10-foot sheets), plasma cutting on a 6-by-12-foot table, and rolling and breaking up to 3/8-inch metal. It also operates three overhead bridge cranes — 12.5-ton, 15-ton, and 36-ton — for heavy lifting and precision placement, enabling large-scale structural and industrial fabrication without outsourcing. Commercial ductwork is fabricated to specification, and the shop handles cotton gin maintenance and custom components.

Blytheville Sheet Metal serves commercial, industrial, and agricultural clients across Arkansas, Alabama, Tennessee, Mississippi, and the broader southeastern United States. Its agricultural work includes ongoing maintenance and custom metal components for more than 100 cotton gins in the region. Notable projects include involvement in the construction of Adams Gin in Leachville, Arkansas, one of the largest cotton gins in the country.

The business was built on the principle of doing the job right the first time, a commitment reflected in its BBB accreditation, five consecutive years of NFIB membership, and a Chamber of Commerce business award. Long-standing relationships and repeat clients underscore a reputation for reliability and consistent service.
